summary: No blocking findings; 3 in all. Booted postgres, redis, minio, api, web, worker.

findings.title: The adversary spec copies the helpers and can still pass vacuously
steps: Compare the block() and script() helpers in scripts/pr-title-workflow.adversary.spec.ts with scripts/pr-title-workflow.spec.ts
Note the adversary's read() returns '' for a missing file, block() returns '' for a missing key, script() returns 'exit 2'
findings.evidence: `return existsSync(file) ? readFileSync(file, 'utf8') : '';` and `if (start < 0) return '';`. The code-review fix in auto-run.md made the main spec's helpers throw, but the adversary copies them in their old, silent form. Its many `not.toMatch` assertions (for example `expect(release).not.toMatch(/pr-title/)` and `expect(ci).not.toMatch(/Conventional Commit:/)`) would pass against an empty string. About 35 lines are duplicated (Principle I), and the adversary file has 364 lines for a 34-line workflow. Share one throwing helper, or merge the two specs and keep only the assertions that cover behaviour.

findings.title: Spec assertions reach outside the change: release.yml job wiring and AGENTS.md wording
steps: Read the 'release workflow calling CI' and 'AGENTS.md' describe blocks
findings.evidence: `it('keeps the image job gated on the checks job', ...)` tests release.yml behaviour this PR does not touch, and the AGENTS.md block matches documentation prose with regexes, which breaks on any rewording. Principle II says no padding suites. FR-006 is mapped to the AGENTS.md diff in tasks.md, not to a test.

findings.title: Nothing requires a PR title check to exist on the head commit anymore
steps: Before this PR, CI OK needed pr-title, so a missing title job turned CI OK red
Now merge-gate.mjs requires only `CI OK` by name and judges the checks that are present
findings.evidence: If pr-title.yml did not run for a commit (the workflow disabled, or a run that never started), CI OK is green and the merge gate finds no failing check. That PR would merge with an unchecked title. Today the workflow runs on every opened or synchronize event, so this is a gap in the gate rather than a live failure. Consider having merge-gate also require a `PR title` check.
